JSON of a plot

Source: R/widget.R
plotly_json.Rd

Returns the JSON plotly.js receives for a plot.

Usage

plotly_json(p, jsonedit = interactive(), pretty = TRUE, ...)

Arguments

p

A go_figure() or anything as_widget() accepts.

jsonedit

Show it in an interactive viewer (needs the listviewer package)?

pretty

Pretty-print the JSON?

...

Passed to listviewer::jsonedit().

Value

The JSON string (or a listviewer widget).

Examples

cat(plotly_json(go_figure(go_bar(y = 1:3)), jsonedit = FALSE))
